an4.138:1.1: cattārome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an4.138:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo nikkaṭṭhakāyo hoti anikkaṭṭhacitto
an4.138:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati
an4.138:2.3: so tattha kāmavitakkaṃpi vitakketi byāpādavitakkaṃpi vitakketi vihiṃsāvitakkaṃpi vitakketi
an4.138:2.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo nikkaṭṭhakāyo hoti anikkaṭṭhacitto.
an4.138:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo anikkaṭṭhakāyo hoti nikkaṭṭhacitto
an4.138:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo naheva kho araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati
an4.138:3.3: so tattha nekkhammavitakkaṃpi vitakketi abyāpādavitakkaṃpi vitakketi avihiṃsāvitakkaṃpi vitakketi
an4.138:3.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo anikkaṭṭhakāyo hoti nikkaṭṭhacitto.
an4.138:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo anikkaṭṭhakāyo ca hoti anikkaṭṭhacitto ca
an4.138:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo naheva kho araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati
an4.138:4.3: so tattha kāmavitakkaṃpi vitakketi byāpādavitakkaṃpi vitakketi vihiṃsāvitakkaṃpi vitakketi
an4.138:4.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo anikkaṭṭhakāyo ca hoti anikkaṭṭhacitto ca.
an4.138:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo nikkaṭṭhakāyo ca hoti nikkaṭṭhacitto ca
an4.138:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati
an4.138:5.3: so tattha nekkhammavitakkaṃpi vitakketi abyāpādavitakkaṃpi vitakketi avihiṃsāvitakkaṃpi vitakketi
an4.138:5.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo nikkaṭṭhakāyo ca hoti nikkaṭṭhacitto ca.
an4.138:5.5: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
